a.xlink:title: Worker 1 -- * OfficeAn Office has A Worker. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one Worker.A Worker has some Offices. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.When an Office is created, its Worker must be assigned. When an Office is deleted, its Worker is not deleted and its list of Offices is decreased. When a Worker is deleted, its Offices are not deleted. They are assigned to another Worker.
